evidence: The cyclic pseudo-Anosov action on contractible Teichmuller space is free and properly discontinuous, so its quotient Q is K(Z,1) with nonzero H1 over any field. Verjovsky §5.5 gives proper descending harmonic energy, dE=0 iff Hopf differential is zero, and E minimum exactly least-area fibers. Under explicitly assumed Morse nondegeneracy, weak Morse inequality m1>=b1=1 forces an index-one orbit, which cannot be a global minimum and corresponds to a nonconstant branched minimal immersion. No generic Morse hypothesis is proved.
